messages.en: Review sources, components and runtime capabilities. Enablement and executable consent are managed separately.
messages.zh: 检查来源、组件和运行时能力；启用与可执行授权分别管理。

messages.en: No Toolkits are installed. Install one from a host directory or Git source.
messages.zh: 还没有安装工具包。请从主机目录或 Git 来源安装。

messages.en: Local paths are read by the Vivy host. Browser file selection or upload is not treated as a host directory.
messages.zh: 本地路径由运行 Vivy 的主机读取。浏览器文件选择和上传不会被当作主机目录。

messages.en: Select a Toolkit to inspect its details.
messages.zh: 选择一个工具包查看详情。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.sourceChangeHint.description: Source update and rebind workflow hint

messages.en: These fields are loaded from this Toolkit's current source. Updates prepare a new release; rebind repairs source metadata. Review the candidate before publishing.
messages.zh: 这些字段已载入当前来源。更新会准备新版本；重新绑定只会修复来源记录。检查候选差异后再发布。

messages.en: A candidate is ready. Review its changes before publishing.
messages.zh: 已准备候选变更。检查差异后发布才会生效。

messages.en: Could not prepare the source change. Check the source, Toolkit state and current operation.
messages.zh: 无法准备来源变更。请检查来源、工具包状态和当前操作。

messages.en: A rollback candidate is ready. Review its changes before publishing.
messages.zh: 已准备回滚候选。检查差异后发布才会生效。

messages.en: Could not prepare rollback. Refresh the release list and Toolkit state.
messages.zh: 无法准备回滚。请重新检查保留版本和工具包状态。

messages.en: No component content changes were reported for this candidate.
messages.zh: 本次候选未报告组件内容差异。

messages.en: This change will not cancel or publish until running work finishes.
messages.zh: 运行完成前不会自动取消或发布此变更。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.openMasks.description: Open Mask UI for Toolkit masks

messages.en: Manage origin, copies and use in Masks
messages.zh: 在面具管理中查看来源、复制和使用

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.maskRemovalHint.description: Guide when a candidate removes a Toolkit mask

messages.en: If a conversation uses this mask, select another in Masks.
messages.zh: 若会话正在使用此面具，请在面具管理中重新选择。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.recommendedSkill.description: Mask recommended Skills with the recommendation behavior in one sentence

messages.zh: 推荐 Skill：{{skills}}（不会自动启用）

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.componentCountLi.description: Component count for one inventory section

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.mcpToolsLine.description: Number of MCP tools discovered by the runtime

messages.en: This build does not include this component capability
messages.zh: 当前构建未包含此组件能力

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.stagedComponent.description: Component retained while its owner is unavailable

messages.en: The component remains in the Toolkit, but this build cannot activate it.
messages.zh: 组件会保留在工具包中，但当前构建暂不可用。

messages.en: old consent is stale; confirm again
messages.zh: 旧授权已失效，需重新确认
缺少主机环境变量绑定

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.reauthorizeConse.description: Refresh stale executable authorization for the current declaration

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.enableBeforeCons.description: Executable consent requires an enabled Toolkit

messages.en: Authorization is disabled while the Toolkit is disabled and must be confirmed separately after enabling.
messages.zh: 工具包停用时不可授权。授权仍需在启用后单独确认。

messages.en: Enter host environment variable names only, never secret values. Leave blank to clear a binding.
messages.zh: 只填主机环境变量名，不要输入密钥值。留空会清除此绑定。

messages.en: Host environment references saved. Related Hook/MCP consent must be confirmed again.
messages.zh: 主机环境变量引用已保存。相关 Hook/MCP 授权需要重新确认。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.bindingsConflict.description: Bindings conflict error while retaining form values

messages.en: Bindings were not saved. Configuration may have changed elsewhere; your form values are retained. Refresh and review before retrying.
messages.zh: 绑定未保存。配置可能已在其他位置更新；表单内容已保留，请刷新后核对。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.mcpUnavailable.description: MCP is unavailable after a connection attempt

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.mcpDeferred.description: MCP waits for consent or bindings

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.mcpHealthHint.description: MCP status display does not initiate a connection

messages.en: Runtime status reflects previous connection operations; viewing this page does not contact the server.
messages.zh: 运行状态只反映此前的连接操作；查看此页不会主动连接服务器。

messages.en: Could not read the Toolkit catalog. Check the connection and retry.
messages.zh: 无法读取工具包目录。请检查连接后重试。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.catalogChanged.description: Catalog republished while the installation list was being read

messages.en: The Toolkit catalog was republished while it was being read. Refresh to load it again.
messages.zh: 读取期间工具包目录已重新发布。请刷新以重新加载。

messages.en: Could not read this Toolkit. Refresh and retry.
messages.zh: 无法读取这个工具包的详情。请刷新后重试。

messages.en: The previous operation could not be recovered yet. The server remains authoritative for catalog state.
messages.zh: 上次操作暂时无法恢复。目录仍以服务端状态为准。

messages.en: The operation is still preparing and candidate details are not available yet. The server remains authoritative for catalog state.
messages.zh: 操作仍在准备中，候选信息尚未返回。目录状态以服务端为准。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.releaseDigest.description: Release digest label shown with the SHA-256 value on install, details and content views

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.contentDigest.description: Component content digest label inside the content dialog

messages.en: Preview failed. Check the host path or Git source and retry.
messages.zh: 预览失败。请检查主机路径或 Git 来源，并重试。

messages.en: Toolkit installed disabled. Enablement and executable consent require separate confirmation.
messages.zh: 工具包已安装为停用状态。启用和可执行权限需要分别确认。

messages.en: Installation is not yet confirmed. The same operation ID was checked with the server; review its status before continuing.
messages.zh: 安装结果尚未确认。已尝试按同一操作编号向服务端核实；请查看操作状态后再继续。

messages.en: Could not prepare this change. Check the Toolkit state and current operation.
messages.zh: 无法准备这项变更。请检查工具包状态和当前操作。

messages.en: Publication is not yet confirmed. Check the operation status; do not create a duplicate change.
messages.zh: 发布结果尚未确认。请核对操作状态；不要重复创建新的变更。

messages.en: Cancellation is not yet confirmed. Check the operation status before continuing.
messages.zh: 无法确认取消结果。请检查操作状态后再决定是否继续。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.consentIdentityM.description: Executable declaration identity missing before consent mutation

messages.en: The executable declaration identity is missing. Review the Toolkit before changing authorization.
messages.zh: 缺少已检查的可执行声明身份，无法提交权限变更。

messages.en: Authorization recorded. Runtime will also check bindings and compiled capabilities.
messages.zh: 权限已记录。运行时还会检查绑定和已编译能力。

messages.en: Authorization is not yet confirmed. Inspect the Toolkit again before retrying.
messages.zh: 权限状态尚未确认。请重新检查工具包后再决定是否重试。

messages.en: Could not read component content. The release may have changed; reopen the details.
messages.zh: 无法读取组件内容，可能该版本已更新。请重新打开详情。
在 Skills 管理中查看和使用

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.stateOrphaned.description: Installed Toolkit state: source missing, metadata retained

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.mutationUpdate.description: Candidate mutation verb: update from source

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.installTitle.description: Install Toolkit action and dialog title

messages.en: Install from a host directory or Git repository. A new Toolkit always lands disabled.
messages.zh: 从主机目录或 Git 仓库安装。新安装的工具包始终为停用状态。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.installFailed.description: Install request failed, dialog retains input

messages.en: Could not install this Toolkit. Your source input is kept; check the source and retry.
messages.zh: 无法安装此工具包。来源信息已保留，请检查后重试。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.refreshing.description: Catalog refresh in progress on an existing list

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.ruleFacesLine.description: Faces a Toolkit Rule applies to, as one sentence

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.candidateTargetP.description: Label before the Toolkit a prepared change applies to

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.candidateMutatio.description: Why other changes are unavailable while a candidate waits

messages.en: A pending change blocks other changes. Publish or cancel it first.
messages.zh: 存在待审核变更，其他变更暂不可用。请先发布或取消。

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.blockerRun.description: Run id label inside the candidate blocker list

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.blockerSession.description: Session id label inside the candidate blocker list

plugin.vivy/toolkits-ui.orphanedHint.description: Why an orphaned Toolkit has no lifecycle action

messages.en: The recorded source is missing or was removed. The Toolkit stays listed with its metadata retained.
messages.zh: 记录的来源已缺失或被移除。该工具包会保留元数据并继续列出。
